notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 18479 and 18637.

No objective. Starting cards as posted with '- STARTING': You Cannot Hide Forever, I Will Find Them Quickly, Master, His Name Is Anakin (the three Effects Prepared Defenses deploys) and Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60. No starting location is marked.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list uses Coruscant-set cards (Darth Maul, Young Apprentice, Destroyer Droid, Maul Strikes).
'Weapons and Devices (7)' is a section header, not a card, and was removed; the deck totals 60 as published.
Posted 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace Lower Chamber's' matches no card; it dested Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages, the only Dark Jabba's Palace site with 'Lower' in its name.

Posted Tatooine Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber, Entrance Cavern, Mos Eisley, Cantina and Docking Bay 94 dested the Dark site printings; 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay, as in deck 18479.
Posted 'Vader's Lightsaber' and 'Darth Vader's Lightsaber' are two different cards (Premiere and Death Star II) and are kept as both.
The '?' characters in posted names are DeckTech's rendering of apostrophes (the strategy says so).
